title: Middleware, rate limiting, request lifecycle hooks

preview.what: Middleware and rate limiting: the pipeline every request walks through.
preview.picture: Security checkpoints in a row; each can inspect, modify, or turn you back. Rate limiting is the doorman counting how many times you came in this minute.
preview.why: 'Where would you put X?' questions test whether you understand the pipeline.
preview.bn: সারি সারি checkpoint — দেখতে, বদলাতে, ফেরাতে পারে; rate limit = দারোয়ান গুনছে কতবার এলে।
